subject.title: feat(setup): download-model actions on web and macOS onboarding

question: After real web and macOS proof is supplied and the lint failure is resolved, should this user-facing local-model setup entry point be accepted as the intended onboarding surface?
rationale: The PR is protected with the `maintainer` label and changes first-run onboarding behavior across two product surfaces; the existing prepare transport supports the implementation, but acceptance of this presentation and feature scope remains a maintainer choice.

options.title: Approve the onboarding entry point
options.body: Accept the web and macOS actions once redacted live proof confirms both clients invoke the existing prepare wizard and recover correctly after completion.

options.title: Require a capability-contract follow-up first
options.body: Pause until the Gateway can advertise preparable choices directly if maintainers do not want clients to mirror the current Ollama and llama.cpp choice contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the onboarding entry point
recommendation.body: Accept the web and macOS actions once redacted live proof confirms both clients invoke the existing prepare wizard and recover correctly after completion.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged Gateway and onboarding work shows direct ownership of the transport and both client surfaces.
